packageRules.description: This repository is the source of the @adea-ai/* packages: never self-update an internal package.

Non-major external dependency updates ride one grouped branch per cycle. No auto-merge: GitHub refuses to attach it to a draft PR, and every PR must open as a draft because the code-foundry gates only run on the ready-for-review transition — a human marks each batch ready and merges it once the gates pass.
Major external bumps share one draft PR per cycle instead of one per package — a grouped major PR reads as one upgrade decision.
